_comment: Known-stale evidence, waived explicitly rather than silently. .github/scripts/check_evidence_formats.py fails on any report whose recorded input hash no longer matches the committed input ('staleness is failure', klayout-tools docs/design-evidence-tiers.md). An entry here downgrades one such failure to a loud note -- and only that one: the waiver names the exact report, the exact check, and the exact stale hash. It SELF-EXPIRES: once the evidence is regenerated, the recorded_hash below no longer matches and the checker fails until the entry is deleted. Every entry must name a tracking issue. Waiving without one is a schema error, not a judgement call.

waivers.reason: This 0.3.0-minted report compared against the retired flat rhigh reference value (1919368.0 ohm = 1360*L/W). Issue #563 traced the 0.8.0 deck's +4.2% rhigh extraction delta (klayout-tools#2652 transcribes rhigh.sym's end term 1.6e-4 ohm*m and width offset -0.04 um) and updated layout/lvs_reference.py to evaluate the PDK's own symbol formula, changing RPU's reference value to 1999501.7 ohm. Verified live under klt 0.8.0: this cell reaches status match / error_count 0 against the updated reference. Stale until the DR-0016 backlog re-mint (#561) lands.

Issue #572 re-minted bandgap_top.gds (the core cell gained its HBT base-contact landing strips and the assembly picked up e8f227de, which had never been folded into the committed top GDS), which makes this 0.6.0-minted extraction report stale against the new GDS. It is deliberately NOT re-minted in #572: layout/bandgap_top/bandgap_top.pex.spice is a dut[] entry of the actively cited characterization report (measurements/2026-11-16-characterization-report, T1 item 8, manifest item 8) whose current-design claims (sim/closed-loop-psrr-pex, sim/closed-loop-zout-pex) were measured against exactly this netlist hash — check_report_dependencies.py enforces that pin, and refreshing it requires the new dated characterization report those PEX PVT re-runs produce (#275 owns the grids; the DR-0016 re-mint backlog is #561). #572 measured the re-extraction (kept out of the committed tree): same 275 devices, same 842R/261C/59CC card counts, values shifted by mΩ/fF from the base-contact metal, and the one-point probe on the re-extracted core shows vref within 3 uV of the committed extraction.
